title: América Latina en la Guerra Fría
goal: Read how Kennedy's 1961 Alliance for Progress offered aid conditioned on moderate reform and anti-communist alignment, and why its results varied so much across the region.
grammar: Con tal de que + subjuntivo: una condición explícita

items: Explain what the US began fearing after Cuba's revolution radicalized.
State what program Kennedy launched in 1961.
Explain what recipient governments had to do in exchange for aid.
Describe whether the Alliance for Progress's results were uniform across the region.
Use con tal de que + subjunctive to state an explicit condition.
